# ui::TaskbarProgress

Header: `winui/ui/WindowShell.hpp`.

The taskbar button's progress bar: [Window::taskbar_progress()](window.md#taskbar_progress) is a [Property](../core/property.md) of it, written by the app and shown on the taskbar on every change.

Example: 
```cpp
window.taskbar_progress() = ui::TaskbarProgress{ui::TaskbarProgressState::Normal, 0.4};   // 40 %
window.taskbar_progress() = ui::TaskbarProgress{ui::TaskbarProgressState::Error, 0.4};    // turn it red
window.taskbar_progress() = ui::TaskbarProgress{};                                     // remove it
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `TaskbarProgressState` | `TaskbarProgressState::None` | Whether a bar shows and in which color; None hides it. |
| `value` | `double` | `0.0` | Completion in [0, 1]. |
